offers.productHeadline: Drone + on-roof inspection with a written report
offers.productDescription: A licensed inspector walks the roof, checks decking, flashing, vents and attic ventilation, and sends a photo report with a written estimate. The fee is credited toward any repair or replacement.
offers.planDescription: One-time fee. Credited toward any repair or replacement.

offers.productDescription: Holds your crew and install date and orders materials. The deposit is applied to your final invoice. Your card stays on file so the remaining balance can be billed when the job is signed off.

offers.productHeadline: One visit, one price, most small leaks fixed
offers.productDescription: Flat-rate repair visit: reseal flashings and pipe boots, replace up to 10 damaged shingles, reset popped nails, clear valleys and gutters at the roofline. Includes a 1-year leak warranty on the areas we touch.
offers.planDescription: Flat rate. Up to 10 shingles, flashings resealed.

offers.productHeadline: Remaining balance on a completed roofing job
offers.productDescription: The remaining balance for your completed roofing project, billed after final walkthrough. Your deposit has already been applied.
